coverageContract.caseDenominator: Count of unique cases[].caseId; never discovered test count or Markdown rows.
coverageContract.caseNumerator: Required IDs with exactly one actual child result in this round and status pass; duplicates fail closed.
coverageContract.requirementNumerator: Only implemented requirements whose nonempty requiredCaseIds all pass in this round.
coverageContract.roundIsolation: Never merge successful cases across rounds or commits.
coverageContract.completeGate: False if any requirement is partial/notImplemented, any required case is missing/duplicate/nonpass, or independent full-matrix/issue/invariant gates are absent.

integrationGaps: Real provider and production operations are not executed.
Linux cgroup and Chromium standalone results require stable per-case mapping before full coverage admission.
